parameters.query: SELECT l.id AS listing_id, l.title, l.description, p.niche, p.kind FROM listings l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE l.id = $1;
INSERT INTO mockups (listing_id, prompt, file_path) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING id, listing_id, file_path, created_at;

meta.description: Webhook → fetch listing → build SDXL ComfyUI graph → POST /prompt → poll /history → insert mockups row → respond. Default checkpoint sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors; pass body.checkpoint='flux1-dev.safetensors' for Flux. Image bytes stay in comfyui/output volume; serve them via workflow 02b.
